units.source_text: 然而，今年二月，我去拜訪了疏散到千葉縣船橋市的一位朋友。

en.t: However, in February of this year, I went to visit a friend who had evacuated to Funabashi City in Chiba Prefecture.

units.source_text: 她是我大學時代的校友，現在是某女子大學的講師。

en.t: She was a schoolmate from my university days and is now a lecturer at a certain women's university.

units.source_text: 事實上，我曾委託過這位友人給我的一位親戚說媒，

en.t: In fact, I had asked this friend to arrange a marriage introduction for one of my relatives,
and that was one reason I had gone to see her,

units.source_text: 同時也想順便買一些新鮮的海產品給家人嚐嚐，

en.t: while I also wanted to buy some fresh seafood along the way for my family to try,

units.source_text: 於是，我背上揹包，就出發去船橋市了。

en.t: so I shouldered my rucksack and set out for Funabashi City.

units.source_text: 船橋市是一個毗鄰泥海的大城市。

en.t: Funabashi City was a sizable city beside a muddy sea.

units.source_text: 我的這位朋友是剛遷來不久的新住戶，再怎麼向當地人說明她的門牌號，都打聽不出個一二三來。

en.t: This friend of mine was a new resident who had only recently moved there, and no matter how I explained her house number to the local people, I could not get any clear directions.
